reader_question: How many governments of each kind does the country have?
grade_line: Documented: the Census Bureau’s 2022 count of every government in the country
title: Special districts are the most common kind of government in the country, 39,555 of the 90,888 the Census Bureau counted in 2022.
measure_line: Governments by type, 2022, United States; each circle’s area is in proportion to its count
notes: School systems run by a state, county, city or township count with that government, so independent school districts are not every school system.
chart_notes: The circle the title names, special districts, takes the text’s ink; the others are gray with a thin edge. The federal government and the 50 states print in words, since their circles would draw under a pixel and a few pixels across.
alt: Circles sized by area for five kinds of local government in 2022: special districts, 39,555, the largest; municipalities, 19,491; townships, 16,214; independent school districts, 12,546; and counties, 3,031. One federal government and 50 state governments print in words.
